description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to providing and associating grain types with grain classes in the Orleans framework. It includes the IGrainTypeProvider interface, an implementation AttributeGrainTypeProvider, and the GrainTypeAttribute class used to annotate grain classes with their type information.

classes.name: AttributeGrainTypeProvider
classes.description: Provides grain type information based on custom attributes applied to grain classes, implementing the IGrainTypeProvider interface.

classes.name: IGrainTypeProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attributes that can provide a GrainType for a class they are attached to.

classes.name: GrainTypeAttribute
classes.description: An attribute used to specify the grain type of a class, implementing IGrainTypeProviderAttribute.

methods.name: TryGetGrainType
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the GrainType associated with a given class type.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Returns the GrainType associated with a class, as specified by the attribute.
